name: AI Copilot V3 — Schedule → FastAPI → Report

nodes.name: Schedule Trigger
nodes.notes: Fires every 1 minute for testing. Change to cron for production.

nodes.name: Health Check
nodes.notes: Pings the FastAPI /health endpoint. If this fails — API is not running. Start it with: uvicorn automation.scripts.api:app --reload --port 8000

nodes.name: Run Pipeline
nodes.notes: Calls /analyze-by-path with a CSV file path. Change csv_path to your actual dataset. The API reads it, runs all V2 agents, returns JSON report.

nodes.name: Send Report Email

_notes.purpose: Milestone 2 — n8n orchestrates V2 pipeline via FastAPI. No Execute Command needed.
how_to_test: 1. Install deps: pip install fastapi uvicorn python-multipart
2. Start API from project root: uvicorn automation.scripts.api:app --reload --port 8000
3. Open browser: http://localhost:8000/docs — you should see the API docs
6. Update csv_path in 'Run Pipeline' node to an actual CSV in your data/ folder
7. Click Test Workflow — watch Health Check and Run Pipeline go green
